required_reviewers.role: Independent economic methodology and holdout curator
Provider identity and deliverable correctness reviewer
Separate execution-wallet custodian and budget approver
Existing database, artifact, accessibility and release gate owners

provider.contract: One bounded API/data task with independently specified expected deliverable, invoice/refund terms and observable final settlement

proposed_limits_not_authorized.rail: Existing qualified external Base USDC proof profile, subject to separate approval
proposed_limits_not_authorized.window: one explicitly dated session; start/end unassigned
proposed_limits_not_authorized.unknown_cost_policy: ABORT; no assumed zero gas, verification, probe or recovery cost

preconditions: All independent release approvals and explicit live-pilot authorization
Exact source and deployed schema/artifact identity
No legacy absent/ambiguous authority admitted for new spend
External curator and independent ex-ante valuation with full comparator costs
Credible positive incremental value relative to cheap checks and abstaining, or explicitly authorized measurement-only purpose
Provider finality, response binding, expected output and evaluator independence qualified
Separately held execution wallet, scoped capability, allowlist and combined budget
Reviewed reconciliation, stop and evidence-retention procedures

recovery.ambiguous_submission: STOP new spending; retain pending; query existing durable idempotency reference only
recovery.expired_or_revoked: No new execution; reconcile historical submission only
recovery.failed_deliverable: Record contradicted/disputed/unverified using independent evidence, preserve cost and possible loss
recovery.refund: Never presumed; separately authorized and independently evidenced
recovery.resume_authority: Independent operator after reconciliation and budget verification; no blanket wallet capability
